research_question: Does one Direct Local GAT-MAPPO checkpoint serve different robot counts (3/5/8/10) via max_agents + agent_mask, with padding agents excluded from attention, losses, GAE, rewards and statistics?
main_variable: Agent-count machinery only: max_agents padding capacity and agent_mask exclusion. No reward, MAPPO hyperparameter or action-semantics change.

implementation.max_agents: checkpoint meta field; interaction models run at slot count N with padding slots masked
implementation.agent_mask: [batch, n_agents] bool; GAT keys AND queries masked; losses/entropy/GAE normalized over real slots only; mixed-N batches supported
implementation.env_side: VectorVascularEnv active_robots <= num_robots; padding slots inert (zero state, zero reward, no collisions/lysis/stats); RNG stream unchanged
implementation.parameter_sharing: retained: one set of weights, agents differ only by observation

invariants.legacy_default: active_robots=None and max_agents=0 reproduce fixed-N behaviour bit-identically

validation.pytest: tests/test_variable_agents.py: padded forward/update equivalence for 3/5/8 real agents in a 10-slot tensor; mixed-N batch (3/6/5/2) update; checkpoint reload at n<=max_agents; env bit-identity vs legacy
bugs_found_and_fixed: advantage normalization included padding zeros, coupling update scale to the padding ratio
ctx_all lost the agent_mask through the vectorized reshape branch
validation.smoke: scripts/run_scaling_smokes.sh variable_n: 8-slot tensors, 5 active agents, max_agents=10, 448 transitions, PPO update finite

performance_claim: none: cross-N transfer is a training question requiring new 1M-transition runs; this experiment registers the mechanism and its tests only
